name: table-3d-persisted-model-view-fix
title: Persist and reopen uploaded table 3D models
description: Apply an uploaded 3D model to the selected existing table and reopen that persisted model in the real 3D/AR simulator instead of falling back to the generic first catalog item.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: The GraphQL Table visualConfig field, updateTable mutation, backend sanitizer, permissions, audit logging, and Apollo fragment already support the persisted model payload; this task fixes only the missing frontend caller behavior.
